quest.title: The Last Night, the First Light
quest.description: The Spiralblade has been retrieved. You must return to Piramida without delay.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, looks like we're right on time! This place is absolutely buzzin'!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Everyone's been hard at work these past few days. Now that things have finally settled down, we were able to find a moment to bring everyone together.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It couldn't have been easy for you either.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I only did what was expected of me. But... if you hadn't stepped in when you did, I imagine things might've ended very differently. We might've still won... but not without paying a steeper price.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on, we're in this together, aren't we? No need to be so serious!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Yeah, you're right. Oh, looks like Gramps is about to speak.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: To all our comrades and kin — this isn't just a celebration. It's a moment to honor the struggle behind our triumph.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Let us not forget, while we toast this victory, those who gave everything to make it possible. With their blood, they fulfilled the vow we all once made.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: During this battle, the "Nightmare Orioles" Investigation Squad, led by Illuga, took on what was perhaps the most perilous assignment of all.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: #Notably, {NICKNAME} and {M#his}{F#her} companion stepped forward without hesitation in a time of crisis and stood with us, playing a vital role in the operation's success.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: They braved every danger, pressed on through the storm, and carved a path to victory from the depths of despair.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: The legacy of their deeds, and of all who fought for the living and those yet to come, will be written into history, never to fade.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Yes, we are victorious! That victory came at a heavy price, yes, and we may pause to mourn, to remember the fallen... but we must not be broken by grief.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: The future we fought for is within reach, and we carry the fire of those who lit the way before us. Their light must keep shining, and so we must press on.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: But today, let us raise our glasses: to victory, to the brave souls whose courage will never be forgotten, and to the future we vowed to protect.

dialogues.speaker: Olav
dialogues.text: Illuga! Finally! Starshyna Nikita's been looking all over for you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Starshyna... Nikita?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wait, {NICKNAME}, Nikita... isn't that the same old guy who asked us to look for the Silver Lampwick?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Didn't he say he was just a regular Ratnik?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Ah, my old pops... He probably just meant it as a bit of fun.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: We can talk about that later. For now, let's go update him.

choices.text: He didn't really seem like an ordinary Ratnik...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Gramps, we're back!

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Back safe, I see. How are things at Kipumaki Cliff?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You give a quick rundown of what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Just as I thought... It's clear as day even from here. The Pillar of Embla has fallen to the Abyss... and that undying fiend they call the "Professor."

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: That said, it's been quiet for now. I can only assume Miss Alia is still fighting to keep it at bay.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: She's holding the line for us, and we must make the most of this window.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Thanks to Flins and the others, preparations are nearly complete.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: And now that you've brought back the Spiralblade, the Arrow of Terpikeraunas is finally ready.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Umm... what's the "Arrow of Terpikeraunas"? Is it another super-powerful relic, like the Silver Lampwick and the Spiralblade?

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Haha, it surpasses them both.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Five centuries ago, the Torchforger lacked the strength to vanquish the undying fiend, managing only to seal it beneath Kipumaki Cliff. Even so, he did not waver. Together with the first Moonchanter, they pressed on in hope of a future victory.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: They forged this bow and arrow with ancient craft, so that when the day came to end the undying fiend, it would be ready. Since then, it has been passed down through generations of Lightkeepers.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Now, at last, the time has come for it to fulfill its destiny.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... That sounds amazing! What does it look like? Can we see it?

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: You've seen it already, silly. In fact, we're inside it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y—You're not about to fire us off with it or something... right? Right!?

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: This great mead hall was built to house the Arrow of Terpikeraunas, and the Spiralblade you retrieved is the arrowhead it had long been missing.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: Once the Spiralblade is set in place, the Arrow will be ready to fire.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Indeed it is! But it also serves as the mechanism that shapes the Spiralblade into the arrowhead.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: We need to act before the Cataclysm Egg hatches. This bow and arrow have been passed down for this moment — to end the threat once and for all!

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: While you prepare the shot, that undying fiend will likely lash out one last time. Whatever comes our way, we'll stop it.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: The launching of the Arrow of Terpikeraunas is in your hands.

choices.text: Am I to be shot out along with the arrow?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #So {NICKNAME} really is our last-resort weapon! ... No, wait, that's gotta be a joke!

dialogues.speaker: Olav
dialogues.text: Illuga! Finally! Starshyna Nikita's been looking all over for you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Starshyna... Nikita?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wait, {NICKNAME}, Nikita... isn't that the old guy we bumped into back in Piramida?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Didn't he say he was just a regular Ratnik?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Ah, my old pops... He probably just meant it as a bit of fun.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: We can talk about that later. For now, let's go update him.

choices.text: He didn't really seem like an ordinary Ratnik...

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Go now. Get the sacred blade in place.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I just wish Bjorn could've been here too...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He would've been proud.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Yeah, I'll go visit him in a few days. Let him know how things are in the city... He'd want to know.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: #I hope the food's to your liking, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If only we could party like this every day...

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Every day? That might be a bit much...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm just joking!

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Are you? Still, I can see your point. Let's hope we get more days like this to celebrate.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Good work, everyone. Let's set our duties aside for now. Rest well.

dialogues.speaker: Olav
dialogues.text: Moments like this are rare. Ever since the old man made me squad leader, these gatherings are the only time I really get to catch up with the guys.

dialogues.speaker: Olav
dialogues.text: Stop dallying. The Starshyna is waiting for you at the great mead hall.

dialogues.speaker: "The Professor"
dialogues.text: The gate to the bedeviled sky is open, and still you cling to that puny pittance of kuuvahki as if it matters?

dialogues.speaker: "The Professor"
dialogues.text: Yet... How am I still trapped here? Ah, I see... The Sampo Mill turns its face from me once more.

dialogues.speaker: Alia
dialogues.text: Well, well, look who finally showed up. What an honor.

dialogues.speaker: "The Professor"
dialogues.text: ...Who's there?

dialogues.speaker: "The Professor"
dialogues.text: This form... Relya? Ah, there you are. I knew you were still alive.

dialogues.speaker: "The Professor"
dialogues.text: Now, bend the Sampo Mill's power to my will! You will succeed, with the sacred heir's blood burning inside you... Those other three were laughable failures, but not you, no. You've always been my chosen one.

dialogues.speaker: Alia
dialogues.text: Ha... He really thinks I'm Relya. So the mad monk who could once talk his way out of anything can't even see straight now. How ironic.

dialogues.speaker: "The Professor"
dialogues.text: Relya, do not waver. You haven't forgotten our dream, have you? Don't you want to claim the name and the place that were always meant to be yours?

dialogues.speaker: "The Professor"
dialogues.text: Picture it — an Elysium for the shamed and forgotten, a place where the proud fae nobles sink to their knees before you. And in this royal court of the Pale Star, only I, another human, can make that vision yours.

dialogues.speaker: "The Professor"
dialogues.text: And now I stand just one step from the star-bound ascent... When the Elysium beyond the heavens unfolds upon this world, all others will be swept aside, leaving only us, the chosen few, to inherit what remains.

dialogues.speaker: "The Professor"
dialogues.text: When that dawn comes, all the rot of this age will be washed away. Tell me, is that not the world you always hoped for?

dialogues.speaker: Alia
dialogues.text: No. That future was never his desire... And how could you still be peddling the same lie at a time like this?

dialogues.speaker: Alia
dialogues.text: You were using him from the very start. Every promise, every lie, you spun them all to make him seize the Sampo Mill for you. And that "Elysium" you keep preaching about? It was only ever meant for you.

dialogues.speaker: Alia
dialogues.text: Even his fall from rank, the path that turned him into a thief, that too was a trap you devised alongside Grand Duke Alvis. All of it.

dialogues.speaker: Alia
dialogues.text: You might have called me Relya by mistake, but it suits me all the same. I carry his role and legacy, and the name Reed Miller is one I will take without hesitation.

dialogues.speaker: Alia
dialogues.text: Rauthvangi. Mad monk. "Professor." Undying serpent... Your story ends here. I will end it in Reed Miller's name.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: We really did it...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: That undying fiend is well and truly buried...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Twice shall that undying serpent rise again, but thrice shall he be struck down... And at last shall he be laid to rest by the heroes of the sublunary sphere..."\nStanding alongside the courageous Ratniki, you defeat the "Professor" at long last...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: For several days afterward, you stay in Piramida...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: #Cheers! {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: With good company, warm laughter, and flowing drinks, you enjoy a brief moment of peace...

talks.objective: Go to the great mead hall

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Good! The control room's open!
